report:
U području metafize tibije, lateralno od središnje linije, vidi se polimikrolobulirana intramedularna
tvorba neagresivnih karakteristika, heterogenih, predominantno viših T2 intenziteta signala koji
će prvenstveno odgovarati hondroidnom porijeklu. Lezija je ukupnih dimenzija 19x22x30mm
(APxLLxCC), bez vidljive periostalne reakcije i bez vidljivog zahvaćanja kortikalisa - prvenstveno
će odgovarati enhondromu.
Denudacija hrskavice patele u centralnom dijelu kranijalno na arealu veličine oko 6mm (CC) sa
vidljivim manjim subhondralnim edemom u smislu hondromalacije IV. stupnja.
Stanjena hrskavica oba femoralna kondila i tibijalnog platoa uz mjestimične zone hondormalacije
II. stupnja - početne OA promjene.
Bez izljeva.
Medijalni menisk je izmjenjenog intenziteta signala u smislu blaže miksoidne degeneracije.
Uz anteriorni dio trupa sitne ganglion ciste koje najvjerojatnije pripadaju medijalnom patelarnom
retinakulumu koji je promijenjene strukture, vjerojatno ranija ozljeda.
Vidi se kompleksna ruptura trupa lateralnog meniska koja seže do obje artikualcijske površine.
Stražnja i prednja ukrižena sveza su primjerenog intenziteta signala, bez vidjivih znakova
rupture.
Oba kolateralna ligamenta su primjerenog intenziteta signala, bez znakova rupture.
Tendinopatija tetive m.popliteus umjerenog stupnja. Tetive pes anserinusa i iliotibijalni trakt
primjerenog prikaza, bez znakova rupture.
Izmjenjen intenzitet signala tetive kvadricepsa i patelarnog ligamenta na mjestu hvatišta na
pateli u smislu entezopatskih promjena. Edem suprapatelarnog masnog jastučića. U području
koljena vidljiv edem potkožja.

Ön çapraz bağ ve arka çapraz bağ, lateral ve medial kollateral ligaman normaldir.Distal kuadriseps ve patellar tendonlar normaldir. Patella normal yerleşimlidir. Retinaküler devamsızlık yoktur.Diz ekleminde mayi artışı görüldü.Diz eklemini oluşturan kemik yapıların sinyal intensiteleri doğaldır.Patellar kartilaj medial kesimde grade 2-3 dejenerasyon alanları izlendi.Popliteal bölgede 3 cm çaplı baker kisti izlendi.Troklear kartilajda fibulasyon mevcuttur. Sonuç: Patellar kondromalazi, Eklemde efüzyon, Baker kisti, Medial menisküste dejenerasyon .

COMPARISON:Prior right knee MRI from [Date].

CLINICAL HISTORY:Suspected osteoarthritis/internal derangement right knee.

PROCEDURE:Multisequence multiplanar unenhanced MRI of the right knee according to routine protocol.

IMAGING FINDINGS:

Nondiagnostic scout localizing images reviewed.

Diminutive appearance of the posterior horn of the medial meniscus consistent with complex tear, progressed since <[YEAR]>. Diminutive appearance of the medial meniscal body consistent with complex tear. There is peripheral extrusion of the medial meniscal body. The anterior horn is intact.

Intrasubstance degeneration posterior horn of the lateral meniscus without discrete tear. No lateral meniscal extrusion.

Low-grade partial-thickness tear of the anterior cruciate ligament without tibial translation, new since previous study. The posterior cruciate ligament is intact.

The medial collateral ligament and posterior oblique ligament are intact. The fibular collateral ligament is intact. The popliteus and biceps femoris tendon attachments are intact. The interval and is intact.

The patellar retinacula are intact. No patellofemoral subluxation. No femoral trochlear dysplasia. The TT-TG distance measures 10 mm, within normal limits. The quadriceps and patellar tendons are intact. Mild edema of the suprapatellar fat pad suggesting patellofemoral maltracking.

There is mild to moderate generalized patellofemoral chondrosis, progressed since previous study. There is extensive fissuring and thinning of medial femorotibial articular cartilage with small focal areas of full-thickness cartilage denuding, progressed since <[YEAR]>. Within the lateral formidable compartment, there is thinning of articular cartilage involving the central weightbearing aspect of the left femoral condyle and overlying the lateral tibial plateau, progressed since previous study.

Small knee joint effusion. Baker's cyst, measuring 30 x 19 x 65 mm.

Regional musculature is within normal limits. No suspicious focal marrow signal alteration. 

IMPRESSION:
1. Progressive complex tearing of the posterior horn and body of the medial meniscus and progressive tricompartment chondrosis most pronounced involving the medial femorotibial compartment, consistent with progressive moderate to severe medial compartment predominant tricompartment osteoarthritis of the right knee.
2. Since <[YEAR]>, interval development of low-grade partial-thickness tear of the anterior cruciate ligament without tibial translation.
3. 30 x 19 x 65 mm Baker's cyst.

Exam Date and Time: [DATE] [TIME]
Indication: Right knee buckling. Osteoarthritis. ACL sprain. Medial meniscus tear. 
Comparison: [REDACTED]. 

TECHNIQUE:  Multiplanar and multisequence MRI of the right  knee without IV contrast.   

FINDINGS: 

JOINT EFFUSION:  Small joint effusion. Small leaking popliteal cyst. 

ANTERIOR CRUCIATE LIGAMENT:  Intact. 

POSTERIOR CRUCIATE LIGAMENT:  Intact. 

MEDIAL MENISCUS: Large horizontal undersurface tear of the body and posterior horn of the medial meniscus. There is also low-grade tearing of the posterior root attachment. Mild peripheral meniscal extrusion. 

MEDIAL COMPARTMENT:  Subchondral fracture line is noted along the weightbearing segment of the medial femoral condyle, with probable nondisplaced osteochondral lesion. This measures 15 mm AP and 10 mm transverse. Moderate degree of associated bone marrow edema.

There is also mild medial compartment osteoarthritis, with subchondral cystic changes of the tibial plateau. 

LATERAL MENISCUS:  Intact.

LATERAL COMPARTMENT:  Within normal limits. 

MEDIAL COLLATERAL LIGAMENT:  Edema along the medial collateral ligament suggestive of grade 1 sprain pattern. No discrete tear. 

LATERAL COLLATERAL LIGAMENT COMPLEX:  Intact.

PATELLOFEMORAL COMPARTMENT: Low-grade fissuring of the patellar cartilage. No high-grade or full-thickness cartilage defect. No subchondral edema. 

EXTENSOR APPARATUS:  Superior and inferior patellar enthesophytes. Small interstitial tear in the proximal patellar tendon. 

BONE MARROW:  As above. 
 
OTHER:  None. 


IMPRESSION:

1. Large horizontal undersurface tear of the body and posterior horn of the medial meniscus. Mild peripheral meniscal extrusion.

2. Subchondral fracture line of the medial femoral condyle, likely in the context of nondisplaced osteochondral lesion.

3. Mild medial compartment osteoarthritis.

4. Grade 1 sprain pattern of the medial collateral ligament. Intact cruciate ligaments.

5. Small knee joint effusion and leaking popliteal cyst.
